name: apixa
description: Define your API once. Use it everywhere.

scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @apixa/core typecheck && pnpm --filter @apixa/mocking typecheck && tsc --noEmit -p tests/tsconfig.json
scripts.example: pnpm --filter @apixa/core build && pnpm --filter @apixa/mocking build && pnpm --filter @apixa/example-basic start
scripts.example:next: pnpm --filter @apixa/core build && pnpm --filter @apixa/mocking build && pnpm --filter @apixa/example-next dev
